versions.changelog: Add 13 WeChat article themes, four layout profiles, and legacy theme compatibility.
Add five selectable WeChat layout themes and document complete Markdown rendering support.
Continue to unpaid rich-text rendering when review output is rejected, while showing an unreviewed warning.
Always render WeChat-ready rich text with portable inline styles, including text-only articles.
Use Pixmind Builder provider credentials through the secure content bridge; remove the Builder environment-variable requirement.
Use a 960x540 16:9 cover consistent with the other official Pixmind skill cards.
Generate, review, illustrate, and format WeChat articles for rich-text copy into the editor; API publishing remains optional and is no longer used by the skill.
Add private content-engine orchestration, Pixmind image tasks, WeChat rendering, idempotent drafts, and guarded publishing.
